headline: Sensex off lows as Nifty reclaims 25,500 led by IT gains; Tata Steel, Titan drag

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Nifty IT index gained 2%, helping indices recover from lower intraday levels.
Tata Steel, Titan, and JSW Steel traded lower, pulling down the benchmark indices.
IndiGo and Tata Motors PV are among 10 Nifty stocks facing earnings downgrades.
The Indian Rupee appreciated by 17 paise to 93.15 against the US dollar.
whatHappening: Nifty recovered from session lows to reclaim the 25,500 mark.
Gold prices fell below Rs 1,23,000 per 10 grams and silver moved near Rs 1,48,000 per kg.
Cyclone Akvan landfall process began near Gopalpur with heavy rainfall in Odisha.
Data of Visa, Mastercard, and JPMorgan customers was exposed in a ransomware attack.
summary: Indian markets witnessed volatility as Sensex and Nifty traded lower early on before off-low recovery saw Nifty reclaim 25,500. A 2% rise in Nifty IT provided support while metal stocks like Tata Steel and JSW Steel remained key drags. Additionally, the rupee strengthened to 93.15 per US dollar.
